verifyPrev.futureEditionText: 27 May 2027, single-day fifth edition, Restaurant Le Chef at Genève Aéroport, Geneva, Switzerland. Within the requested horizon. TRAVEL INSIDE’s 12 October 2026 announcement explicitly states “le GVA Workshop vivra sa 5e édition le 27 mai 2027 au restaurant Le Chef de l’aéroport de Genève”; this is the activity date, not the publication date. The Swiss Travel Federation’s official industry calenda
verifyPrev.venueText: Le Chef publicly announced for 2027; no public contract/exclusivity terms. No lodging commitment verified.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: PARTIALLY RESOLVED: Nicolas Simonin is a verified GVA Workshop operational contact: the official 2026 event page directs exhibitor registrations to him, and the exhibitor dossier identifies his development role. TRAVEL INSIDE explicitly names Nicolas Simonin and Yves-Daniel Viredaz as organizers in 2025; both also appear in the 2026 organizing team. They are commercially relevant contacts to approach about 2027, but no reviewed 2027-specific source names either as that edition’s appointed organizer or hotel buyer. Continuity into 2027 is an inference, not verified authority.
findings.futureEdition: Fifth edition announced for 27 May 2027 at Restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport. The 12 October 2026 article explicitly gives the event date; the FSV industry calendar corroborates it.
findings.venueCommitments: Restaurant Le Chef at Genève Aéroport is publicly announced for 2027. Contract terms and exclusivity are not established by the reviewed sources. This is a restaurant, not an incumbent hotel.
findings.accommodationSourcing: No 2027 accommodation buyer, hotel block, room requirement or open hotel-sourcing process is established by the reviewed event announcements. Announced meeting venue does not establish lodging commitment.
findings.organizationStructure: Genève Aéroport is the event organizer. TRAVEL INSIDE is identified as media partner in the 2025 event report; do not treat it as the hotel buyer.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nicolas Simonin at the publicly listed nicolas.simonin@gva.ch, referring specifically to 27 May 2027. First confirm his responsibility for that edition and ask whether any airline representatives or organizers need overnight accommodation, who arranges it, and whether lodging is already contracted. Use Yves-Daniel Viredaz as an organizer-side escalation/referral contact. Do not pitch replacement of the announced Le Chef venue.
